name: gmti-high-clutter
label: Wide-area GMTI, heavy clutter
description: For GMTI over busy or cluttered ground where most plots are noise: few, confident tracks. Real traffic on a sparse scene may not form tracks at all.
basis: Benchmark, Garden Island GMTI (very noisy): clutter density 1e-6 gives 17 system tracks in 40 min (1.3 live) where 3e-8 gave about 1,150; 3e-6 gives almost none. On the Stuart Highway recording it forms no tracks: use gmti-wide-area where the traffic is real and sparse.
